=== help
biab — Builders in a Box CLI
  biab           resume the installer from the last completed step
  biab status    short summary: phone-app service, setup steps (--json for state.json)
  biab logs      follow the bootstrap log
  biab update    pull latest BIAB + re-run install scripts (no reinstall needed)
                 biab update --latest   install the newest upstream Claude Code, Codex,
                                        Paseo and agy instead of the tested versions
                                        (unsupported; 'biab update' returns to them)
  biab auto-update  scheduled 'biab update', off until you turn it on
                 biab auto-update on [weekly|daily|monthly|'Mon 03:30']  |  off  |  status
                                        (it runs plain 'biab update': on a box that used
                                         --latest, the next run puts it back on the tested versions)
  biab add       install an optional bundled skill or skill group (e.g. 'biab add incident', 'biab add handover', 'biab add marketing')
  biab subscription  see the AIs on this box, or add one ('biab subscription add codex')
                 (also: 'biab ai', same thing)
  biab pack      manage opt-in heavyweight capability packs
                 (browser: a sandboxed headless Chromium the agent can drive.
                  night-shift: overnight work on specs you have validated —
                  installed switched OFF, and it spends your subscription
                  once you switch it on, so read what it prints.)
                 biab pack list            show available packs + status
                 biab pack add <name>      install a pack
                 biab pack remove <name>   uninstall a pack
  biab worktrees clean [--dry-run] [--yes]
                 retire the worktrees of merged pull requests; shows what goes and why the rest stay
  biab paseo     the phone-app service (needs sudo)
                 biab paseo pair [--rotate]   show host/port/password and confirm
                                              pairing; --rotate makes a new password
                 biab paseo restart           restart it and clear a "gave up" state
  biab lang      show or change the language (English or Español): biab lang [en|es]
  biab help      this message
[rc=0]
=== help-dash
biab — Builders in a Box CLI
  biab           resume the installer from the last completed step
  biab status    short summary: phone-app service, setup steps (--json for state.json)
  biab logs      follow the bootstrap log
  biab update    pull latest BIAB + re-run install scripts (no reinstall needed)
                 biab update --latest   install the newest upstream Claude Code, Codex,
                                        Paseo and agy instead of the tested versions
                                        (unsupported; 'biab update' returns to them)
  biab auto-update  scheduled 'biab update', off until you turn it on
                 biab auto-update on [weekly|daily|monthly|'Mon 03:30']  |  off  |  status
                                        (it runs plain 'biab update': on a box that used
                                         --latest, the next run puts it back on the tested versions)
  biab add       install an optional bundled skill or skill group (e.g. 'biab add incident', 'biab add handover', 'biab add marketing')
  biab subscription  see the AIs on this box, or add one ('biab subscription add codex')
                 (also: 'biab ai', same thing)
  biab pack      manage opt-in heavyweight capability packs
                 (browser: a sandboxed headless Chromium the agent can drive.
                  night-shift: overnight work on specs you have validated —
                  installed switched OFF, and it spends your subscription
                  once you switch it on, so read what it prints.)
                 biab pack list            show available packs + status
                 biab pack add <name>      install a pack
                 biab pack remove <name>   uninstall a pack
  biab worktrees clean [--dry-run] [--yes]
                 retire the worktrees of merged pull requests; shows what goes and why the rest stay
  biab paseo     the phone-app service (needs sudo)
                 biab paseo pair [--rotate]   show host/port/password and confirm
                                              pairing; --rotate makes a new password
                 biab paseo restart           restart it and clear a "gave up" state
  biab lang      show or change the language (English or Español): biab lang [en|es]
  biab help      this message
[rc=0]

choose Direct connection and enter:

  Port:      6767
  Password:
  sekrit

Leave "Use SSL" off. Your phone needs Tailscale switched
on.

The app lists this box under a long name that starts
with "biabox" (its machine name).
To rename it, open the host's settings in the app and tap
the pencil.

When the app shows your box, press Enter.
Type s to skip.
>

=== guard-codex-note
note: ~/.codex/config.toml has hooks of its own. Codex warns about two hook files each session; that is normal and not from BIAB.
(its hooks screen, or [features] hooks = false in config.toml)[rc=0]
=== guard-opencode-note
PARTIAL: N deny rules in ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json: a different, smaller coverage than Claude Code's or Codex's.
Not covered: a pipe into a shell or into fdisk (curl | bash), quoted targets (rm -rf "/"), rm -rf /*, commands inside bash -c,
a renamed fork bomb, a one-line heredoc, a command split over two lines, and any command that does not start with
the tool's own name (sudo -E, env, VAR=1 rm, nohup, doubled spaces).
Known false positives: a quoted > /dev/sda inside text, git push -f to a branch whose name contains main or master.
Not confirmed: subagents obeying these rules. Overridden by a project's own opencode.json that allows everything, and by
the OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT and OPENCODE_PERMISSION environment variables.
[rc=0]
=== guard-unproven
                     installed, NOT verified: Antigravity (agy) loads the plugin, but nobody has seen it block a command yet, so Builders in a Box does not count it
                     installed, NOT verified, and switched off inside Antigravity (agy)
                     installed, NOT verified, and the hooks are disabled (sentinel present)
                     installed, NOT verified, and Antigravity (agy) did not load its hook (or its script or rules file is gone)
                     installed, NOT verified: cannot check what Antigravity (agy) loads right now (command not found or no answer)
                     installed, NOT verified (state: weird)
[rc=0]

=== perm-nohome
the box user's home folder could not be found[rc=1]
=== perm-noconfig
<W>/oc-none/.config/opencode/opencode.json does not exist, and OpenCode's default is to allow edits and shell commands[rc=1]
=== perm-symlink
a symbolic link in the way (BIAB never reads or writes through links in your home folder): <W>/oc-link/.config/opencode/opencode.json[rc=1]
=== perm-jsonc
<W>/oc-jsonc/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc exists next to opencode.json, and BIAB does not merge JSONC[rc=1]
=== perm-badjson
<W>/oc-badjson/.config/opencode/opencode.json is not valid JSON[rc=1]
=== perm-notobj
<W>/oc-notobj/.config/opencode/opencode.json: its top level is not a JSON object[rc=1]
=== perm-nopermission
<W>/oc-noperm/.config/opencode/opencode.json: it has no permission rules[rc=1]
=== perm-wildcard
<W>/oc-wildcard/.config/opencode/opencode.json: a wildcard permission rule can override the rules that ask[rc=1]
=== perm-agentmode
<W>/oc-agentmode/.config/opencode/opencode.json: an agent or mode rule in the same file allows actions without asking (OpenCode applies it after the global rules)[rc=1]
=== perm-editallow
<W>/oc-editallow/.config/opencode/opencode.json: permission.edit does not ask or deny[rc=1]
=== perm-bashallow
<W>/oc-bashallow/.config/opencode/opencode.json: permission.bash does not ask or deny by default[rc=1]
=== perm-overlay-link

=== guard-opencode-overridden-real
the rules are in ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json, but OpenCode's base permission check fails (<W>/oc-none/.config/opencode/opencode.json does not exist, and OpenCode's default is to allow edits and shell commands): an allow of yours that comes before ours is overridden where it overlaps, and an allow in an agent, a mode, ~/.opencode or the workspace opencode.json applies after ours

=== paseo-refuse-symlink
paseo: refusing to continue: <W>/a-link is a symbolic link. BIAB never writes through links in your home folder. Remove the link (or move it away) and run the step again.

=== agy-convert-asks

Antigravity now runs in the Paseo app. It asks before it runs shell commands and
before it writes files in your project, your home folder, ~/.biab or /var/tmp,
and before it reads files outside your project.
It does not ask before it reads inside the project, searches the web, opens web
pages or writes in /tmp. The prompt offers only allow once or reject, with no
always-allow; the Auto Accept switch in the app is separate. (Measured with agy 1.4.11.)
Conversations started in the old full-access mode stay in the app but cannot
be continued: start a new agent. Applying this restarts the phone-app service,
which ends any agent that was running.

[tightened=0]
false
[rc=0]
=== agy-convert-tightened

Antigravity now runs in the Paseo app. It asks before it runs shell commands and
before it writes files in your project, your home folder, ~/.biab or /var/tmp,
and before it reads files outside your project.
It does not ask before it reads inside the project, searches the web, opens web
pages or writes in /tmp. The prompt offers only allow once or reject, with no
always-allow; the Auto Accept switch in the app is separate. (Measured with agy 1.4.11.)
Your agy setting allowNonWorkspaceAccess was true; it is now false, which is
what makes reads outside the project ask.
Conversations started in the old full-access mode stay in the app but cannot
be continued: start a new agent. Applying this restarts the phone-app service,
which ends any agent that was running.

[tightened=told]
false
[rc=0]
=== agy-convert-noask

Antigravity now runs in the Paseo app. It asks before it runs shell commands and
before it writes files in your project, your home folder, ~/.biab or /var/tmp.
It does not ask before it reads inside the project, searches the web, opens web
pages or writes in /tmp. The prompt offers only allow once or reject, with no
always-allow; the Auto Accept switch in the app is separate. (Measured with agy 1.4.11.)
Reads outside your project do not ask on this box: allowNonWorkspaceAccess in
<W>/agy-home/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json is not false.
Conversations started in the old full-access mode stay in the app but cannot
be continued: start a new agent. Applying this restarts the phone-app service,
which ends any agent that was running.

[tightened=0]
false
